# LibreOffice Calc GUI Interface Description

## Window Title and System Information
- **Application Title**: "Untitled 1 - LibreOffice Calc"
- **System Date and Time**: "Oct 22 22:30" displayed in the top center of the window
- **System Tray Icons**: Located in the top-right corner, including system status icons (e.g., sound, network, battery)

## Application Menu Bar
- **Menu Items**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help
- **Application Name**: "LibreOffice Calc" displayed in the title bar

## Toolbar
- **Icons**: A row of icons for common functions including:
  - File operations (New, Open, Save, Print)
  - Formatting (Font, Size, Bold, Italic, Underline)
  - Alignment and cell formatting
  - Data operations (Sort, Filter, AutoSum)
  - Insertion (Images, Charts, Hyperlinks)
  - Other utilities (Find, Replace, Spell Check, etc.)

## Document Area
- **Grid**: A spreadsheet grid with rows numbered 1 to 42 and columns labeled A, B, C, etc.
- **Active Cell**: Cell A1 is highlighted in orange
- **Formula Bar**: Located above the grid, showing "A1" and formula input fields
- **Font Settings**: "Liberation Sans" font selected, size "10 pt"
- **Sheet Tab**: "Sheet1" is visible at the bottom, indicating one active sheet

## Open File Dialog
- **Title**: "Open"
- **Cancel Button**: Located at the top-left of the dialog
- **Navigation Pane**:
  - **Recent**: Recent files section
  - **Home**: Home directory shortcut
  - **Desktop**: Desktop directory shortcut
  - **Documents**: Currently selected, highlighted in orange
  - **Downloads**: Downloads directory shortcut
  - **Music**: Music directory shortcut
  - **Pictures**: Pictures directory shortcut
  - **Videos**: Videos directory shortcut
  - **Trash**: Trash directory shortcut
  - **Other Locations**: Option to browse other directories
- **Breadcrumb Navigation**: "user > Documents"
- **File List Area**: Empty, no files displayed
- **Column Headers**: "Name", "Size", "Type", "Modified" (with "Size" and "Type" collapsed)
- **Search Icon**: Magnifying glass icon for searching files
- **Open Button**: Located at the top-right of the dialog
- **Version Dropdown**: "Version:" with a dropdown arrow
- **Read-only Checkbox**: "Read-only" checkbox (unchecked)
- **File Type Filter**: "All files" dropdown with a dropdown arrow

## Sidebar and System Tray
- **Application Icons**: Located on the left side of the screen, including:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc (highlighted)
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help
  - Trash
- **System Tray**: Located at the top-right corner, including system status icons

## Status Bar
- **Sheet Information**: "Sheet 1 of 1"
- **Default**: "Default" (likely indicating default theme or style)
- **Language**: "English (Hong Kong)"
- **Statistics**: "Average: ; Sum: 0"
- **Zoom Level**: "100%" with zoom slider

## Additional UI Elements
- **Get Involved Button**: Located in the top-right corner of the spreadsheet area
- **Donate Button**: Located below "Get Involved" button
- **Help Messages**: Two informational messages displayed in the top-left corner:
  - "Help us make LibreOffice even better!"
  - "Your donations support our worldwide community"
- **Vertical Scroll Bar**: Located on the right side of the spreadsheet area
- **Horizontal Scroll Bar**: Located at the bottom of the spreadsheet area
- **Grid Lines**: Visible grid lines separating cells in the spreadsheet
- **Row and Column Headers**: Row numbers on the left and column letters at the top of the grid
- **Sheet Tab Bar**: Located at the bottom of the spreadsheet area, showing "Sheet1" as the active sheet
- **Navigation Controls**: Located at the bottom-left of the spreadsheet area, including:
  - Previous sheet button
  - Next sheet button
  - First sheet button
  - Last sheet button
  - Sheet number indicator
- **Zoom Controls**: Located at the bottom-right of the spreadsheet area, including:
  - Zoom slider
  - Zoom percentage indicator
  - Zoom in/out buttons
